verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.trykintsugi.com with a structured Kintsugi Developer Docs summary. Kintsugi also documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search its docs and the live OpenAPI spec directly, without needing credentials. Missing for 10: a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration that the MCP docs server works in practice.
